_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F12, the ledger's second page.

text.zh_TW: 懸賞單底下壓著另一頁名冊：「十二歲以上的孩子，全數帶走。其中『有記號的』一名，交主人親自處理。」
text.en: Under the bounty notices lies another page of the ledger: "All children over twelve to be taken. The one 'marked' child to be handled by the Master himself."
